entries.headline: Six US transports and NATO radar aircraft reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six US military transport aircraft over the United States and mentioned a NATO radar aircraft. The visible post is truncated after saying activity had risen sharply and referring to multiple large cargo aircraft.

entries.headline: Five coded broadcasts and US strategic aircraft reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported five coded US Air Force radio broadcasts during the day and multiple heavy transport aircraft over the United States, including a surveillance aircraft and a nuclear command aircraft.

entries.headline: US military aircraft over North Sea and five coded broadcasts reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported multiple US military transport aircraft over the North Sea alongside surveillance and command aircraft, plus five coded US Air Force radio broadcasts during the day.

entries.headline: US transport and surveillance aircraft with five coded broadcasts reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported US Air Force transport and surveillance aircraft over the United States and five coded radio broadcasts during the day. It said the latest broadcast occurred before 4am, without specifying a timezone.

entries.headline: US military aircraft and elevated European activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported a US Air Force surveillance aircraft, radar aircraft and transport aircraft over the continental United States, with military flight activity in the Eastern Mediterranean and North Sea at roughly three to four times its stated normal level.

entries.headline: US transports, surveillance aircraft and coded broadcasts reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported multiple US Air Force transport aircraft and a surveillance aircraft over the United States, two coded radio broadcasts during the day and elevated activity over the Eastern Mediterranean and North Sea.

entries.headline: Air traffic suspension in Kuwait reported
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a report, attributed to “ww3 monitor” and @gamermodeflex, that air traffic had been suspended in Kuwait.

entries.headline: Gulfstream FAZE31 reported airborne
entries.summary: War Watch reported Gulfstream 5 registration 19-5591 using callsign FAZE31 and hex AE1436, attributing the sighting to reagan0965 and the photograph to CJMoeser via Planespotters.net.

entries.headline: Explosions near Strait of Hormuz and US military activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported heavy explosions in the southern Strait of Hormuz, US military transport aircraft active over the continental United States and coded US Air Force radio traffic.

entries.headline: C-17A MCFAMC reported airborne
entries.summary: War Watch reported Boeing C-17A Globemaster registration 08-8197 using callsign MCFAMC and hex AE2FA9, attributing the sighting to reagan0965 and the photograph to Luca Knopp via Planespotters.net.

entries.headline: TC-135W OLIVE27 reported airborne
entries.summary: War Watch reported Boeing TC-135W registration 62-4127 using callsign OLIVE27 and hex AE1254, attributing the sighting to reagan0965 and the photograph to Alon Varshaver via Planespotters.net.

entries.headline: Eastern Mediterranean activity reported near three times normal
entries.summary: War Watch reported military air activity in the Eastern Mediterranean at nearly three times its stated normal level, alongside multiple US transport aircraft over the United States.

entries.headline: P-8 airborne alert at Kadambuttur
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an OFF Ground alert for a military P-8 aircraft at Kadambuttur, India. The callsign was shown as NA.

entries.headline: E-3 NATO40 on-ground alert at Geilenkirchen
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an ON Ground alert for Luxembourg-registered E3TF aircraft NATO40 at Geilenkirchen, Germany.

entries.headline: P-8 airborne alert at Thiruthani
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an OFF Ground alert for a military P-8 aircraft at Thiruthani, India. The callsign was shown as NA.

entries.headline: P-8 on-ground alert at Darwin
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an ON Ground alert for a Royal Australian Air Force P-8 Poseidon at Darwin, Australia. The callsign was shown as NA.

entries.headline: P-8 BFLO72 on-ground alert at Burton
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an ON Ground alert for Australian-registered military P-8 aircraft BFLO72 at Burton, Australia.

entries.headline: P-8 airborne alert at Fallon
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an OFF Ground alert for a US military P-8 aircraft at Fallon, Nevada. The callsign was shown as NA.

entries.headline: SkyGlass shares report on possible KC-10 second life
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a The War Zone report that retired KC-10 Extender tankers could receive a second life with an unidentified North African operator.

entries.headline: P-8 airborne alert at Orange Park
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an OFF Ground alert for a US-registered military P-8 aircraft at Orange Park, Florida. The callsign was shown as NA.

entries.headline: E-6 airborne alert at Suisun
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an OFF Ground alert for a US military aircraft labelled E6 at Suisun, California. The callsign was shown as NA.

entries.headline: P-8 PDN01 on-ground alert at Marton
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an ON Ground alert for New Zealand-registered military P-8 aircraft PDN01 at Marton, New Zealand.

entries.headline: SkyGlass shares report on X-BAT drone development
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a The War Zone report that the US Navy was accelerating development of the X-BAT vertical-takeoff-and-landing fighter drone toward flight testing and operational readiness.

entries.headline: SkyGlass shares report on AERIE counter-drone prototype
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared an Army Technology report that Rheinmetall and Praetorian Aeronautics had delivered the AERIE autonomous counter-drone prototype.
